title: Validation: compare Fleet proof against bare vLLM
description: Record setup steps, prerequisites, cold start, failure recovery, and operator-debugging flow for Fleet proof versus bare vLLM; add KServe/Dynamo baseline only if setup effort is acceptable.

logs.msg: Planning note: Host prerequisites document is the first required Phase A exit gate deliverable. Must cover: NVIDIA driver version, nvidia-container-toolkit version, containerd config diff, CDI generation, minimal test model (Llama 3.2-3B-Instruct). Write this before implementing agent code.
